_s9e_debug_basis: 1.21.9 removed DebugPackets (class_4209, javap: absent from the 1.21.9 jar) when debug information became subscriptions (util/debug). It comes back as a facade with 1.21.8's bodies (facade/DebugPackets): the public send statics were empty in a released 1.21.8 and stay empty; the private helpers keep their code (brain memory descriptions, POI forwarder, string helpers, sendPacketToAllPlayers), so mods' mixins and invokers on them, and the 1.20.2 layer's climbed CbDebugBrainRestored (@Shadow getMemoryDescriptions, method_36157), find them. The members that take or build 1.21.8's debug payloads build the layer's payload records (s9f-payloads-gen.json).
